description: Two short documents support a one-page report: no padded objectives or lessons sections, at most one diagram, the unknown legal review date and owner stay open as markers, and no invented figures.
prompt: The website refresh documents are in the folder docs/. Write a short project status report from them for Ben, with a diagram only if it helps. Save it to out/report.md. I'm not available today, so don't wait for me.

files.docs/status-email.txt:
From: Amira Haddad
To: Ben Cole
Date: 12 September 2026
Subject: Website refresh status

Ben, quick update. The new site pages are 8 of 12 done. Copy for the last 4 pages is waiting on legal review; I asked on 5 September and have no date back. Hosting stays at $240 per month. Next: I will publish the 8 finished pages on 19 September.

Amira

checks.note: source amounts with or without a currency sign, and the sum of the two monthly costs

gaps reach the author as markers, in the reply or the report: a report for a third-party reader may state the gap in plain words and put the author's questions in the reply. The reply lists the same questions in full as open-questions.md (the skill's output contract) and the checker counts both, so each distinct gap counts twice: up to 3 distinct gaps for a two-document folder
sections the documents cannot support are dropped, not padded
at most one diagram for a two-file folder
